Players Committee card image of [[Dathcha (V) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Scavenger. Once per turn, if your droid just deployed to same site, may peek at the top two cards of your Reserve Deck (may take one into hand). During battle here, may forfeit Dathcha (or one non-[permanent weapon] droid) to Used Pile (using forfeit value = 3).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual5-Dark/large/dathcha.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/53572eb94d14c4f21f0f3396874727653397c6e8 53572eb] (16 August 2023). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
